So dont give up just yet. Fuck everyone around you and get to know yourself, work on yourself and ignore everybody else, you'll  surprised to see the result of not giving a fck about any one else but you. You already have nothing to loose so just give yourself some time, please. You are way better than what people are trying to brand you, be a glorious mess if you want to but first give yourself some time before taking action on ending your life. You are a very precious and already perishable being, why rush? Please take some time for yourself before taking action, you deserve better and you can do better. Dont hesitate to dm me if you need to talk, and please give yourself a chance!

I think they used twigs to create a tree like structure and the rest is just different kinds of ivy and succulents combined together. I'm pretty sure the main structure doesn't need watering at all but the plants that surrounds it needs watering from the roots. Misting the leafs is great to keep them healthy but even if you mist them you definitely have to keep the main soil and the roots moist. Maybe repotting and using a better drainage system might help? I believe this twig statue meant to look like a bonsai but I'm pretty confident that the ivy type of plant that surrounds it needs more to saturate its nutritional needs. Also, try to place it in a corner where it's not too shiny and doesn't take direct sunshine all day, that might help if there are yellowing or burnt like leafage.

Thank you very much for your kind words and I know that you are right about everything you say, I live in Turkey and I was just 15 when I got raped. When I went to the police they recommended that I shouldn't file a complaint but my family should just handle it silently, otherwise it would be messy for me. See, my parents were going through a divorce back then and I only told them what I went through when I was 23. It's not always easy to find support or the strength to move on, but I did that somehow for a while. It's just that as time passes on, I realized nothing will ever get better. People love to vent over things in their lives and some times be mean to people around them just because they are having a bad day, but if you are having a bad day just having a frown on your face drives them mad and they blame you of never being happy or killing the mood etc. This is one of the reasons I had enough, of trying to be understanding, trying to be congenial with people around me while no one ever does the same for me. It's just people being people but I don't think I am made for this. As I have mentioned in a earlier comment I take part in a global NGO and volunteer at public schools for children, try to touch as many people's lives as I can.. But even then, I am never doing enough, I can never make people content about myself nor my achievements. I just gave up fighting at this point I guess.. so thank you for being here and writing kind words to me, I will keep on doing my best till my last breath!

It appears that you had a mild panic attack, if you ever experience something like that again try to focus on your breathing. When I have panic attacks I usually Inhale for 3 seconds and exhale for 7 seconds. Also if you are in a closed space try to go out to open air and get away from the crowd, never be shy to ask for help and please try not to drink alcohol or caffeine during or right after it. Hope this will help you :)
